await (async(page)=>{
const out=[];await page.getByRole('tab',{name:'Miramar',exact:true}).click();out.push({case:'history-filter',rows:await page.locator('tbody tr').count(),maps:await page.locator('tbody tr').evaluateAll(es=>[...new Set(es.map(e=>e.children[3]?.textContent))])});
await page.goto('https://aevic-demo.netlify.app/team/sharecards/?type=leaderboard&tournament=19130ea6-8fc0-4bc6-9773-12b1a49de0a5');await page.getByRole('button',{name:'PNG yüklə',exact:true}).waitFor({timeout:30000});await page.reload();await page.getByRole('button',{name:'PNG yüklə',exact:true}).waitFor({timeout:30000});out.push({case:'share-reload',qaPresent:(await page.locator('main').innerText()).includes('[QA-2026-11]'),text:(await page.locator('main').innerText()).slice(0,1200)});
await page.goto('https://aevic-demo.netlify.app/team/notifications');await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Oxunmuş et',exact:true}).first().waitFor({timeout:30000});const before=(await page.locator('main').innerText()).slice(0,1200);const rr=page.waitForResponse(r=>r.url().includes('/api/')&&r.request().method()!=='GET',{timeout:20000});await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Oxunmuş et',exact:true}).first().click();const response=await rr;await page.reload();await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Oxunmuş et',exact:true}).first().waitFor({timeout:30000});out.push({case:'qa-notification-read',before,status:response.status(),path:new URL(response.url()).pathname,after:(await page.locator('main').innerText()).slice(0,1200)});return out;
})(page);
